title: Import/reimport gltf files causes kernel panic with `forward_plus` or `mobile` on macOS M2
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproductible in : 4.4.0-dev2, and 4.4.x later, 4.5.x
- Not reproductible in : 4.4.0-dev1, 4.3.x and earlier

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable.mono - macOS Sequoia (15.5.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M2 Pro (Apple8) - Apple M2 Pro (10 threads)

### Issue description

When importing *.gltf files in the project, the computer screen flickers with black glitches which if happens too long (> ~4 seconds) makes my Macbook to panic and reboot. The duration of the flickering is random. It happens with multiple gltf models, even small ones. 

I was not able to find any relevant logs about the issue when the editor flickers or make the Macbook panics.

### Steps to reproduce

- create new project
- set the rendering to forward_plus or mobile rendering method
- add/update a gltf file from the filesystem
- go to Godot window to trigger auto reimport
- the screen flickers with black glitches

The issue also happens:
- when selecting a gltf file in the filesystem, going to the import tab, hitting Reimport button
- spam hitting the Reimport button makes the flicker last longer and crash the laptop

The issue does not happens:
- when opening advanced import window of a model and hitting reimport button
- when the rendering method is compability

Tried to change `rendering/rendering_device/driver.macos` project setting to "vulkan" but it had no effect.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[mrp_gltfimportpanicforwardplus.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20431932/mrp_gltfimportpanicforwardplus.zip)
